findings.title: Effect on `changed-symbols` is not stated
findings.detail: `cli::resolve_base` (src/cli.rs:467) is shared by `run_changed_symbols` (src/cli.rs:451) and the impacted-tests/run path (src/cli.rs:598). If base resolution starts returning an 'unborn' outcome, the outline should say what `changed-symbols` does with it. The safest choice is to keep today's exit 2: it is an inventory, so it has no run_all to fall back to, and its exit-code contract is 0 or 2 only. The brief should state this so dev doesn't invent a new behaviour.

findings.title: run_all must come before `git diff` and `untracked`
findings.detail: On an unborn HEAD there is no merge-base, so `changed_report`'s `git.diff(&base.merge_base)` would fail. The unborn verdict has to come out at the `resolve_base` call site, before `changed_report` runs. It also has to come before `tyf` discovery, matching the existing invariant that up-front verdicts are checked before `tyf` is looked for. The outline implies this but doesn't say it. Worth one sentence in the brief, plus a test with an empty `PATH`, like the existing up-front-verdict tests.

findings.title: Replay no-go is respected
findings.detail: Replay picks its base through `replay_checkout` and `replay_base` (src/cli.rs:653-700), not `resolve_base`, so the planned change doesn't reach it. The brief should still say that `Git::resolve_commit` is out of scope.

findings.title: Scenario, size and appetite fit
findings.detail: One phase, size M, scenario `small` (the default, with a reason given). It covers R1-R4, matches the pitch's one-phase appetite, adds no flags or config keys, and keeps the git spawn inside `git::Git`. Adding a `Reason` variant without bumping the payload version follows the CLAUDE.md rule (adding a variant keeps the version). The guide test that names every `Reason::label` is updated in the same phase, so the gate stays green.
